defect: Operator directive with screenshot: the sticky orange alert banner 'shouldn't be more forward than menus, makes menus unclickable' - with the nav's 'Our work' dropdown open at desktop width, the dropdown items (Coastal Flooding, Past work) were hidden/clipped behind the banner and the region was unclickable.
root_cause: The banner (.alert-strip) and the masthead are sticky siblings both pinned to viewport top:0. The banner's z-index 60 outranked the masthead's z-index 50 in the root stacking context. The dropdown panel's own z-index 60 never competes with the banner: the masthead is a stacking context, so the panel's layer only counts inside it, and the whole masthead - dropdown included - sat below the banner. The banner painted over the dropdown's first item and, when scrolled, over the stuck nav links; at 412 it covered the open MENU panel's links.
